description: Create a luminance mask from a color view: Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B, then an optional blur and shadow clip.

blur.description: Blur sigma applied to the mask (default 5)

clip_low.description: Shadow clip threshold, below which the mask is 0 (default 0.10)

gamma.description: Gamma curve applied to the mask (default 1.0)

name: create_luminance_mask
